associations.rationale: The formal theorem gives the sink-side disjunction that an indecomposable is simple at the sink or has a surjective sink map. The displayed claim instead asserts the nonsimple consequence and also includes the separate source case, so this declaration is only partial, consequence-level evidence.

The formal theorem gives the source-side disjunction that an indecomposable is simple at the source or has an injective source map. The displayed claim instead asserts the nonsimple consequence and also includes the separate sink case, so this declaration is only partial, consequence-level evidence.
